paite: Nou Galatia mihaite aw, kua'n hon bumhai amaizen a? Na mitmuh ngei ua Jesu Khrist kilhden a kichiantak a lahsak zaw hiven maw.
heading: Dan leh Ginna
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth among you as crucified?

paite: Hiai leltak ka hon dong ding; dan thilhihte ziak in hia Kha na muh uh, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
english: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

paite: Hichi tel in na hai uh maw? Kha a pan khin ngal in, sa in na zou ding ua hia?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

paite: Thil huchi zahzah athawn a thuak na hi uh maw? Athawn taktak na hitaleh.
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

paite: Na kiang ua Kha hon pepa leh na lak ua thillamdang hihpa'n dan thilhihte ziak in hia ahih, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

paite: "Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huai ginna diktatna a simsak ahih tak mah bang in,"
english: Even as Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in thei un, ginna a omte Abram tate ahi uhi.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.

paite: Huan Laisiangthou in, "Pathian in ginna ziak in Zentelte siamtangsak ding in akisa chih theikhol in, nangmah ah namte vualzawlsak in a-om ding uh," chi in Abraham kiang ah tanchinhoih ana genkholta hi.
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.” Genesis 12:3; 18:18; 22:18

paite: Huchi in ginna a omte ginna mipa Abraham toh vualzawlsak in a-om sam nak uhi.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

paite: Dan thilhih a kinga peuhmahte hamse nuai ah a-om uhi, "Dan laibu a thugelh tengteng bang a hih gige lou peuhmah hamsiat in om hen," chi a gelh ahi.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.” Deuteronomy 27:26

paite: Tu in Pathian mitmuh in kuamah dan a siamtang a-om kei, "Midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding,” chih ahih ziak in chih alang kilkel hi.
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.” Habakkuk 2:4

paite: Himahleh dan zaw ginna a kinga ahi kei; huchibang a hihpa huaite in ahing ding chih ahi zaw hi.
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.” Leviticus 18:5

paite: Eite sik in Khrist hamsiat in ahong om a, dan hamsia a kipan in ahon tankheta hi, "Sing a khailup peuhmah hamsiat hi hen," chih gelh ahih bang in.
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” Deuteronomy 21:23

paite: Huchi a Abraham tung a vualzawlnate Khrist Jesu ziak a Zentelte tung ahong tun theih a, ginna ziak a chiam a om Kha pen i muhtheihna ding in.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

paite: Unaute aw, mihing hihdan in gen leng; mihing thukhun leltak leng, hihkipsa nung aphel kei ua, behlap leng abehlap ngei kei uhi.
heading: Dan leh Thuchiam
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.

paite: Abraham kiang ah leh achisuante kiang ah thuchiamte piak ana hi. Mi tampi tungthu gen bang in, "Chisuante kiang ah," achi kei a; mi khat tungthu gen bang in, "Nang chisuan kiang ah," achi zaw a, huai tuh Khrist ahi.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn’t say, “To seeds,” as of many, but as of one, “To your seed,” Genesis 12:7; 13:15; 24:7 which is Christ.

paite: Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi; huai thuchiam bangmah lou suaksak a hihmang ding in, thukhun Pathian in ana hihkipsa, anung kum zali-le-sawmthum khit a hong om, dan in ahihmang thei kei hi.
english: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

paite: Gouluah ding thu dan ziak ahihleh thuchiam ziak ahita kei ding a; himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah thuchiam ziak in ahi ana piak.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

paite: Ahihkeileh bangchi thu a dan om ahia le? Chisuan thuchiamna ahong om masiah tatleknate ziak in behlap in a-om a, angelte zang a palai khut a hihkip ahi.
english: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

paite: Huan palai himhim mi khat lak ah palai ahi ngei kei hi; Pathian bel khat ahi.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

paite: Ahihkeileh dan in Pathian thuchiamte akalh hia? Kalh lou hial! Hihhing thei himhim dan piak a om na hitaleh, dan ziak in diktatna a-om ngei ding hi.
heading: Dan In Atup
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

paite: Himahleh Jesu Khrist gin ziak a thilchiam a gingtate kiang a piak ahihtheihna ding in Laisiangthou in khelhna nuai ah bangkim akhakkhum vekta hi.
english: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

paite: Himahleh ginna ahong tun ma in ginna hong kilang ding ah khakkhum in dan nuai a ven i na hi uhi.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

paite: Huchi in ginna ziak a siam i tantheihna ding in huai dan tuh Khrist hon chilpa ahi.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

paite: Himahleh ginna ahong tun in, hon chilpa nuai ah i omta kei uhi.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

paite: Khrist Jesu gin ziak in Pathian tate na hi vek uhi.
heading: Pathian Tate
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

paite: Noute Khrist a baptis lut a omsate Khrist in na kithuamta uhi.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

paite: Huai ah Juda mi a-om kei a, Grik mi leng a-om kei; huai ah sikha a-om kei a, noplen leng a-om kei; huai ah pasal leh numei leng a-om kei hi. Khrist Jesu ah na vek un pum khat na hi uhi.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

paite: Huan Khrist a na hih uleh Abraham suan thuchiam bang a gouluah dingte na hi uhi.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to promise.
